import ast,gzip,json
from hashlib import sha256
import run_sqrt2_power_wave as wave
root=wave.ROOT/'research/arithmetic-library/sqrt2-power/observations';driver='scripts/run_sqrt2_power_wave.py'
current_tree=ast.parse((wave.ROOT/driver).read_bytes())
def functions(tree):return {n.name:n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
def branch(tree,function,case):
    found=[]
    for node in ast.walk(functions(tree)[function]):
        if not isinstance(node,ast.If):continue
        t=node.test
        if isinstance(t,ast.Compare) and isinstance(t.left,ast.Name) and t.left.id=='identifier' and len(t.ops)==1 and isinstance(t.ops[0],ast.Eq) and len(t.comparators)==1 and isinstance(t.comparators[0],ast.Constant) and t.comparators[0].value==case:
            found.append([ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in node.body])
    assert len(found)==1,(function,case,len(found));return found[0]
entries=[('AP047','half-log-square','v2'),('AP048','square-error-linear','v1'),('AP049','half-log-root-comparison','v1'),('AP050','half-log-root-witness','v1')];rows=[]
for case,slug,version in entries:
    folder=root/f'shared-wave-{slug}-{version}'
    ha=json.loads((folder/'report.json').read_text());lean=json.loads((root/f'shared-wave-{slug}-lean-v1/report.json').read_text());tests=json.loads((root/f'shared-wave-{slug}-validation-v1.json').read_text())
    result=ha['results']['fresh_replay'];check=lean['checks'][0];target=wave.formula_sha256(wave.target_for(case))
    assert ha['status']=='fresh_ordinary_HA_checked' and lean['status']=='fresh_lean_checked' and tests['status']=='passed'
    assert result['target_ast_sha256']==check['target_ast_sha256']==target and result['bundle_sha256']==check['bundle_sha256']
    old=result['source_pins'];current=wave.pins(case)
    assert {k:v for k,v in old.items() if k!=driver}=={k:v for k,v in current.items() if k!=driver}
    with gzip.open(folder/ha['source_snapshots'][driver],'rb') as stream:raw=stream.read(old[driver]['bytes']+1)
    assert dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha256(raw).hexdigest())==old[driver]
    historical=ast.parse(raw)
    for name in ('run','replay','check_forged_root_rejection','generation_phase_limits','replay_phase_limits'):
        assert ast.dump(functions(historical)[name],include_attributes=False)==ast.dump(functions(current_tree)[name],include_attributes=False),(case,name)
    for name in ('pins','target_for','worker'):assert branch(historical,name,case)==branch(current_tree,name,case)
    assert result['false_target_rejected'] and result['forged_body_rejected'] and check['independent_lean_checked']
    rows.append(dict(case=case,target_ast_sha256=target,bundle_sha256=check['bundle_sha256'],nodes=result['local_nodes'],constructors=result['proof_nodes'],all_requested_batches=tests['completed_batches'],HA_and_fresh_Lean_same_data=True,all_producer_and_kernel_source_pins_current=True,historical_controller_authenticated=True,relevant_controller_functions_and_case_branches_AST_unchanged=True))
assert len({r['target_ast_sha256'] for r in rows})==4
print(json.dumps(dict(authority='metadata_consistency_only_not_new_proof_authority',new_checked_statements=rows,IR072_closed=False,public_checkpoint_changed=False)))
